manifest.name: @goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent
manifest.description: DSH plugin: ACP agent framework with GLM and MiniMax model clients
manifest.author: goodjin

bundle.text:
# @goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent 的挂载配置。
#
# 这是 ACP 接入层 + 模型客户端 + preset 框架的浏览器/宿主组合行。它把外部 agent
# （codex/claude/grok/cursor/zcode/minimax/qoder 走 ACP，zcode/minimaxi 是模型插件）
# 接进 DSH，并提供名册过滤器与各家配额胶囊后端。
#
# 历史上这些挂载行住在 threadharbor（@goodjin2/dsh-threadharbor）的
# cordis.patch.yml 里。2026-11 调整边界：threadharbor 收敛为纯多主机插件
# （host-federation + 并入的联邦 UI），agent/配额表面整体迁到本仓。两个仓库
# 的 patch 现在各自独立，profile 按需安装其一或两者。
#
# 用法：把下面的 insert 段合并进你的 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml。

- insert:
    # 自报门面：boot 之后打一行「几行挂上、缺哪几行、为什么缺」，并把同一份账目挂到
    # 只读路由 /acp-agent/health。
    #
    # 为什么要有这一行：2026-11-03 一句参数属性让主入口在 strip-only 载入时直接失败，
    # 整个插件的宿主半边与浏览器半边一起消失（设置里的屏蔽页、模型前缀、配额胶囊全没了），
    # 能看见的地方一个字都没有——当时是靠「某条配额路由存不存在」这种副作用才查出来的。
    # 它故意不 import 包内任何东西，所以主入口坏掉时它照样能载入并说话。
    #
    # 放第一位：它排的那次核对在 boot 之后跑，位置靠前只是让它在别人坏掉时也一定存在。
    - id: acp-agent-health
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/health'
    # 浏览器半边的挂载行。DSH 不按 package.json 的 dsh.client 自动装载浏览器包：
    # 客户端模块系统扫的是 Loader 的行，只有 name 恰好等于包名（裸包名）时那个包
    # 才会进 window.__DSH_BOOT__（子路径行，比如下面的 /roster-filter，不算）。
    # 这一行只挂名不干活（clientOnly），presetId/agent 只为过 schema 校验。
    # 少了它：设置里的「屏蔽提供方与模型」、配额胶囊、ACP 过程视图一起消失，
    # 宿主日志一个字都没有。
    - id: acp-agent-client
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
      config:
        clientOnly: true
        presetId: acp-agent-client
        agent: codex
    # 名册过滤器不点名。每个要藏起的 preset 在自己的 binding 上打
    # hideFromRoster: true；过滤器只认这个标记（以及行上的同名字段）。
    # 新增 agent 只要打标记，不必改过滤器配置。内部 list() 仍不过滤。
    - id: acp-agent-roster-filter
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/roster-filter'
    # GLM 套餐限额接口：宿主解密本机 ZCode 登录密钥后问一次 Coding Plan 的
    # monitor 地址，把 5 小时/周两个窗口的数字发回；浏览器侧输入框下方的
    # 配额胶囊从这里读（密钥不出宿主进程，成功应答带 30 秒缓存）。
    - id: acp-agent-zcode-quota
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/zcode-quota'
    # MiniMax Token Plan 限额+积分接口：宿主用本机 MiniMax 登录令牌（签名查组与
    # 积分 + 开放平台查两个窗口）问一次，把 5 小时/周/积分发回；与 GLM 那条同面，
    # 浏览器侧给 MiniMax 模型画配额胶囊时读它（令牌不出宿主进程，30 秒缓存）。
    - id: acp-agent-minimaxi-quota
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/minimaxi-quota'
    # Codex（ChatGPT 套餐）额度接口：宿主读本机 ~/.codex 登录令牌问一次官方
    # usage 只读接口，把主/次窗口（时长决定标签）与按量积分发回；没登录就
    # 不出数据，浏览器侧按 acp:acp-codex 画胶囊（令牌不出宿主，30 秒缓存）。
    - id: acp-agent-codex-quota
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/codex-quota'
    # Claude（Anthropic 官方订阅）额度接口：宿主读本机官方 OAuth 令牌（文件或
    # 钥匙串）问一次 oauth usage，把 5 小时/7 天两档发回；走中转站没登官方的
    # 机器上没有凭据，胶囊安静地不出现（上游接口自带 429 冷却，缓存 2 分钟）。
    - id: acp-agent-claude-quota
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/claude-quota'
    # Grok（grok-cli 的 SuperGrok/GrokPro 套餐）额度接口：宿主读本机
    # ~/.grok/auth.json 的 OAuth 令牌问一次 grok-cli 代理域的
    # /v1/billing?format=credits（周窗 + creditUsagePercent）与
    # /v1/user?include=subscription（档位，进悬停提示）。令牌约一小时过期、
    # CLI 自己续；过期/没登录就折成 ok:false，胶囊安静地不出现（30 秒缓存）。
    # 必须走 cli-chat-proxy.grok.com：直接打 grok.com 被 Cloudflare 盾拦。
    - id: acp-agent-grok-quota
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/grok-quota'
    # 外部 agent 委派回调路由：桥接进程（bridge/dsh-acp-mcp-bridge.mjs，由外部 agent
    # 自己拉起）把 delegate 工具调用 POST 到这里，本校验行配置令牌后转交宿主服务
    # superpowers.delegation。鉴权不走 connection.admit（那是浏览器 cookie 面；
    # 回调方是本机子进程，admit 会一律 401），走本行 config.token 与请求头
    # x-dsh-delegation-token 的逐字比对。token 是令牌的唯一来源：会话侧从同一行
    # 读出同一个值放进桥接进程的 env，两处各配各的会让回调永远 401。留空 =
    # 回调一律拒绝（fail closed）；要用委派就在 profile 里把它设成长随机串。
    - id: acp-agent-delegation-route
      name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/delegation-route'
      config:
        token: ''
    - id: acp-codex
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-codex
        name: Codex
        order: 20
        plugins:
          - id: acp-codex-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-codex
              agent: codex
              hideFromRoster: true
              command: /Users/good/.local/bin/codex-acp
              # 静默看门狗的期限放宽到 5 分钟（默认 120 秒）。
              #
              # 2026-10-21 桌面版现场：codex 在大仓里干活（一万个文件的索引）
              # 时，工具结果落地后它要等模型的下一次回答；这一等常常超过两分钟，
              # 而它在等的时候不吐任何帧——在外面看与「卡死」一模一样，120 秒的
              # 看门狗就把这一轮杀了（同一会话当天四次 ACP_STALLED）。进程没死、
              # stderr 也是空的，它只是在等。
              stallMs: 300000
              # 不写 cwd。写了也会被忽略。
              # 外部会话只用这条 DSH 会话自己的工作区；没有工作区就不开工。
              # mode 留空 = 该构建的默认 agent（"Approve for me"）。
              # 清单 = 2026-11-01 真机探针（对该命令做一次真实
              # initialize + session/new）读到的 models.availableModels，
              # 一字不差。codex-acp 2.5.0（自带 codex CLI 0.165.0）：
              # 46 个组合 id，含 6.1 系列；首报落地后选择器以运行时报告为准。
              models:
                - id: "gpt-6.1-sol[low]"
                  name: "6.1 Sol (low)"
                  description: "Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Fast responses with lighter reasoning"
                - id: "gpt-6.1-sol[medium]"
                  name: "6.1 Sol (medium)"
                  description: "Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Balances speed and reasoning depth for everyday tasks"
                - id: "gpt-6.1-sol[high]"
                  name: "6.1 Sol (high)"
                  description: "Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Greater reasoning depth for complex problems"
                - id: "gpt-6.1-sol[xhigh]"
                  name: "6.1 Sol (xhigh)"
                  description: "Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Extra high reasoning depth for complex problems"
                - id: "gpt-6.1-sol[max]"
                  name: "6.1 Sol (max)"
                  description: "Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Maximum reasoning depth for the hardest problems"
                - id: "gpt-6.1-sol[ultra]"
                  name: "6.1 Sol (ultra)"
                  description: "Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Maximum reasoning with automatic task delegation"
                - id: "gpt-6-astra[low]"
                  name: "6 Astra (low)"
                  description: "Frontier intelligence for the most demanding tasks. Fast responses with lighter reasoning"
                - id: "gpt-6-astra[medium]"
                  name: "6 Astra (medium)"
                  description: "Frontier intelligence for the most demanding tasks. Balances speed and reasoning depth for everyday tasks"
                - id: "gpt-6-astra[high]"

                - id: "gpt-6-astra[xhigh]"
                  name: "6 Astra (xhigh)"

                - id: "gpt-6-astra[max]"

                - id: "gpt-6-astra[ultra]"

                - id: "gpt-6.1-terra[low]"
                  name: "6.1 Terra (low)"
                  description: "GPT-6.1 Terra Codex model. Fast responses with lighter reasoning"
                - id: "gpt-6.1-terra[medium]"

                - id: "gpt-6.1-terra[high]"

    - id: acp-claude
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-claude
        name: Claude
        order: 30
        plugins:
          - id: acp-claude-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-claude
              agent: claude
              hideFromRoster: true
              command: /Users/good/.local/bin/claude-agent-acp
              # claude 默认 bypassPermissions，不显式写 default 它永远不问。
              mode: default
              # 清单 = 2026-10-10 真机探针（对该命令做一次真实
              # initialize + session/new）读到的 model 配置项 options，
              # 一字不差。
              # 强度档位：claude 的 effort 选项（真机 session/new 的 configOptions[thought_level]）。
              efforts:
                - id: low
                  name: Low
                - id: medium
                  name: Medium
                - id: high
                  name: High
                - id: xhigh
                  name: xHigh
                - id: max
                  name: Max
              models:
                - id: default
                  name: Default (recommended)
                  description: IQuest-Q1[1m]
                - id: opus
                  name: IQuest-Q1
                  description: Custom Opus model
                - id: fable
                  name: IQuest-Q1
                  description: Custom Fable model
                - id: sonnet
                  name: IQuest-Q1
                  description: Custom Sonnet model
                - id: haiku
                  name: IQuest-Q1
                  description: Custom Haiku model
    - id: acp-grok
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-grok
        name: Grok
        order: 25
        plugins:
          - id: acp-grok-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-grok
              agent: grok
              hideFromRoster: true
              # grok 不是 stdio 子进程，而是一个 WebSocket 服务：preset-dispatch
              # 会先拉起 `grok agent serve`（随机端口 + 密钥、等它就绪、关闭时
              # 回收），再连上它返回的 ws url。command 指向 grok 二进制本身。
              command: /Users/good/.local/bin/grok
              # 静默看门狗的期限放宽到 5 分钟（默认 120 秒）。
              #
              # 2026-10-28 桌面版现场（session-983e4ad7）：grok 说完最后一段
              # 文字就转入自动压缩上下文（它自己的 updates.jsonl 记着 93% /
              # 238k token），此后 120 秒零帧，看门狗把这一轮杀了。这台机器上
              # 历史压缩耗时 50–121 秒，120 秒的期限本身就贴着最坏情况；与
              # codex / qoder 一样改成 5 分钟。
              stallMs: 300000
              # 清单 = 2026-10-23 真机探针（grok 1.0.67 的 session/new）
              # 读到的 availableModels，一字不差。
              #
              # 2026-10-23 桌面版现场：清单里只写了 grok-4.7，而当时跑着的
              # grok 进程报的是 grok-4.6 / grok-4.5（它的模型清单缓存在
              # ~/.grok/models_cache.json，缓存旧了就不含 4.7）。用户在选择器里
              # 点了 grok-4.7，agent 那边根本没有这个模型，这一轮直接作废。
              # 清单写成真机的样子，选择器在 agent 自己报清单之前就不会给出
              # agent 做不到的选项。
              # 强度档位：grok 的 reasoning_effort 选项（`grok --help` 记的 minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh，这里取四档）。
              efforts:
                - id: low
                  name: Low
                - id: medium
                  name: Medium
                - id: high
                  name: High
                - id: xhigh
                  name: xHigh
              models:
                - id: grok-4.7
                  name: Grok 4.7
                - id: grok-4.7-build-fast
                  name: Grok 4.7 Fast
                - id: grok-4.6
                  name: Grok 4.6
                - id: grok-4.5
                  name: Grok 4.5
    - id: acp-cursor
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-cursor
        name: Cursor
        order: 35
        plugins:
          - id: acp-cursor-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-cursor
              agent: cursor
              hideFromRoster: true
              # cursor 的 ACP 走 stdio：`agent ... acp` 一配就自启动。
              # 注意：cursor 的二进制也叫 agent，但 ~/.local/bin/agent 是 grok
              # 的（会冲突）——这里必须指向 cursor 自己的 agent 二进制。本机
              # 装好后改成真实路径，例如 ~/.local/bin/cursor-agent。
              command: /Users/good/.local/bin/cursor-agent
              # cursor 的 modelId 带配置后缀（grok-4.7[context=256k,...]），是
              # 不同的配置组合而非推理档位，不能按 effort 归并——否则不同的
              # 配置会被压成一行。关掉归并，每个 id 独立成行。
              collapseEfforts: false
              # 清单 = 2026-09-14 真机探针（captured-frames.cursor.json 的
              # session/new）读到的 availableModels，一字不差。
              models:
                - id: grok-4.7[context=256k,reasoning_effort=high,fast=true]
                  name: grok-4.7
                - id: claude-opus-5-5[context=300k,effort=medium,fast=false]
                  name: claude-opus-5-5
    - id: acp-zcode
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-zcode
        name: ZCode
        order: 40
        plugins:
          - id: acp-zcode-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-zcode
              agent: zcode
              hideFromRoster: true
              # zcode 是模型插件，不是 ACP 进程。本机 ZCode 登录密钥解密后，
              # 对话按 Coding Plan 的地址发给 GLM；读文件、跑命令、审批、
              # 取消和会话记录仍由 DSH 自己的循环处理。模型出现在列表的
              # ZCode 这一组里。默认推理档是 high；选 none 会关掉思考。
              # 国际站账号把 ZCODE_GLM_BASE_URL 设成
              # https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic 。
              # 强度档位：zcode 的思考档（none 关思考；low/high/max 是它接受的值）。
              efforts:
                - id: none
                  name: None
                - id: low
                  name: Low
                - id: high
                  name: High
                - id: max
                  name: Max
              models:

    - id: acp-minimax
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-minimax
        name: MiniMax
        order: 45
        plugins:
          - id: acp-minimax-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-minimax
              agent: minimaxi
              hideFromRoster: true
              # minimaxi 是模型插件，不拉起任何进程。本机 MiniMax Code 的登录
              # 凭据按官方那套路径与刷新逻辑读取（与桌面版共用同一个文件和同一把
              # 锁），对话发给 MiniMax 的托管网关；区域从凭据所在目录读出，国内站
              # 自动走 agent.minimax.cn。读文件、跑命令、审批、取消和会话记录仍由
              # DSH 自己的循环处理。
              #
              # 没装或没登录 MiniMax Code 时，这一组模型发消息会直接失败并说明
              # 去哪登录——本插件不另设密钥。
              #
              # 思考档位是 MiniMax 自己的 low/medium/high/xhigh/max；M3.1-Flash
              # 关不掉思考，选 none 会被忽略（官方对 disabled 直接返回 2013）。
              # 强度档位：minimax 的思考档（Flash 关不掉思考，所以不列 none）。
              efforts:
                - id: low
                  name: Low
                - id: medium
                  name: Medium
                - id: high
                  name: High
                - id: xhigh
                  name: xHigh
                - id: max
                  name: Max
              models:
                - id: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
                  name: M3.1 Flash
                  description: MiniMax Code 登录
                - id: MiniMax-M3
                  name: MiniMax M3
                  description: MiniMax Code 登录
    - id: acp-qoder
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-qoder
        name: Qoder
        order: 50
        plugins:
          - id: acp-qoder-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-qoder
              agent: qoder
              hideFromRoster: true
              # Qoder 的 CLI 默认是交互式 agent；`--acp` 由共享参数表补上
              # （packages/dsh-acp-agent/src/spawn-args.ts），这里不重复。
              # 国际站把 command 指向 `qoder`/`qodercli`；本机是 CN 版。
              command: /Users/good/.local/bin/qoderclicn
              # 静默看门狗的期限放宽到 5 分钟（默认 120 秒）。
              #
              # 2026-10-28 桌面版现场（会话 a655a45d）：qoder 执行长工具（跑了个
              # python 并发下载测速）期间一个帧都不发——模型请求期间思考帧照常流，
              # 不发帧的是工具在跑的那段。那个工具跑满约 120 秒被 qoder 自己的
              # Bash 超时终止（18:35:12.956），我们的 120 秒看门狗 5 毫秒后跟进
              # （18:35:12.961），而它马上就要开始下一轮模型请求（+300ms）——
              # 两个 120 秒定时器的赛跑，放宽到 5 分钟后 qoder 自己的超时先解决
              # 战斗，回合不死。与 acp-codex 同款放宽。
              stallMs: 300000
              # 登录走 `qoderclicn login`，凭据留在 CLI 自己的
              # ~/.qoder-cn 配置目录。无头部署可改用 PAT：
              # 宿主进程设 QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN 即自动登录（官方
              # ACP 文档写明的路径；spawn 的 env 白名单会放行它，见
              # spawn-args.ts）。已登录时会话不需要 authenticate；只有 session/new
              # 报认证错误时才补一次 authenticate 并重试（2026-10-20 实测：
              # 已登录时调用 authenticate 偶尔会挂满超时）。
              # 默认模式就是逐次询问；写出来是不让构建的默认值漂移。
              mode: default
              # 清单 = 2026-10-20 真机探针（qoder-cli-cn 1.1.6，真实
              # initialize + session/new）读到的 models.availableModels，一字不差。
              models:
                - id: auto
                  name: Auto (default)
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · 0.50x Credit
                - id: fast
                  name: Fast
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · 0.80x Credit
                - id: qmodel_38max
                  name: Qwen3.8-Max
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.50x Credit
                - id: qfmodel
                  name: Qwen3.8-Flash
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.00x Credit
                - id: qmodel_latest
                  name: Qwen3.7-Max
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.50x Credit
                - id: qmodel
                  name: Qwen3.7-Plus
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.10x Credit
                - id: q37fmodel
                  name: Qwen3.7-Flash
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.10x Credit
                - id: dmodel
                  name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.50x Credit
                - id: dfmodel
                  name: DeepSeek-Flash
                  description: Vision · New · 0.00x Credit
                - id: gmodel
                  name: GLM-5.3
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.80x Credit
                - id: gfmodel
                  name: GLM-5.3-Flash
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.10x Credit
                - id: gm51model
                  name: GLM-5.2
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.60x Credit
                - id: kmodel_latest
                  name: Kimi-K3
                  description: Vision · New · 1.40x Credit
                - id: kmodel
                  name: Kimi-K2.8-Preview
                  description: Reasoning · Vision · New · 0.80x Credit
                - id: mmodel
                  name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
                  description: Vision · New · 0.10x Credit

    - id: acp-doubao
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: acp-doubao
        name: Doubao
        order: 57
        plugins:
          - id: acp-doubao-binding
            name: '@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent'
            config:
              presetId: acp-doubao
              agent: doubao
              hideFromRoster: true
              # 我们自己的 ACP 服务（src/doubao/）：它驱动豆包桌面端那个
              # Chromium 外壳的网页，把回答从页面上读回来。豆包的模型请求由它
              # 自己发出（浏览器端签名），我们不直连接口。
              #
              # command 指向 node，args 指向本插件构建出的服务入口
              # （package.json 的 bin: doubao-acp）。路径按本机 profile 的
              # link 安装写死，与其它几行 agent 一样的做法。
              command: /Users/good/bin/node
              args:
                - /Users/good/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/lib/src/doubao/main.js
              # 驱动浏览器的一轮比本地 CLI 慢：页面轮询 + 豆包自己的工具，
              # 120 秒的默认静默看门狗会误杀，放宽到 5 分钟。
              stallMs: 300000
              # 豆包没有可切换的模型清单，选择器只给一项。
              mode: default
              models:
                - id: doubao-default
                  name: 豆包
                  description: 豆包桌面端 · 网页版模型

readme.text:
[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that connects external coding agents to DSH's native session interface. Supports GLM (ZCode), MiniMax, Codex, Claude, Grok, Cursor, and Qoder.

- **ACP agent framework** — transports (stdio, WebSocket), per-agent dialects, frame projection, terminal & file sub-protocols
- **GLM (ZCode) model client** — decrypts local ZCode login, calls GLM Coding Plan, streams responses
- **MiniMax model client** — reads/refreshes MiniMax Code credentials, calls managed gateway
- **Preset dispatch** — registers external agents as DSH presets, takes over sessions, routes turns, handles model switching
- **Quota endpoints** — host-side GLM/MiniMax/Codex/Claude/Grok quota routes (credentials never leave the host process)
- **Roster filter** — hides marked presets from the new-session picker
- **Mermaid asset** — serves the Mermaid rendering runtime on demand
**Browser side** (`./client` entry, auto-loaded by DSH Web via the `dsh.client` declaration):

- **Quota pills** — the GLM/MiniMax/Codex/Claude/Grok pills under the composer, polling the host routes
- **Model visibility panel** — settings section to hide providers and models from the pickers
- **Model label** — the composer's model chip
- **Switch feedback** — handover notice and switch progress bar when the conversation moves to a new session
- **Turn recovery** — the expand button for interrupted no-text turns; resend for requests that never entered the transcript
- **ACP process view** — terminal/file step rendering for external agent turns. It
  works standalone and, when `@goodjin2/dsh-chat-area` is installed, plugs into that
  package's `assistant-step` wrapper through the seat
  `conversation.chat.node.acp-segment-renderer` (chat-area owns the declaration).

readme.section: MiniMax login: refresh, and what happens when it can't
readme.text:
The MiniMax client borrows the local MiniMax Code login
(`~/.minimax/auth/<buildEnv>/<region>/mcode-public/auth.json`) and refreshes it through
the same official OAuth core — same credential store, same cross-process lock — so a
refresh here never invalidates the desktop app or the CLI.

When the refresh token itself is dead, retrying is pointless, so the plugin now says
*where to authorize* instead of failing quietly:

readme.section: MiniMax login: refresh, and what happens when it can't
MiniMax login: refresh, and what happens when it can't
readme.text:
The link comes from the same device-authorization flow the desktop app uses
(`POST /oauth2/device/code` → `verification_uri_complete`). The plugin starts one in the
background and waits at most 3 s for the prompt, because while MiniMax Code is running it
holds the auth lock and our login has to queue: the first response may carry just the
account origin, and the next poll (30 s later) the complete link with the user code. Once
the user authorizes, the official core writes the new credential back to the shared
`auth.json` and the next call simply works. Tokens never enter these payloads, log lines
or error strings.

readme.section: When a row doesn't mount: the self-report seam
readme.text:
A module that cannot be imported takes its whole row down with it, and it cannot report that
itself. So this package ships one leaf module (`./health`, row `acp-agent-health`) that
imports nothing from the package — it still loads and speaks while everything else is broken.

After boot it prints one line naming what is missing and why:

readme.section: When a row doesn't mount: the self-report seam
readme.text:
```
acp-agent health: 12/13 行已挂载；未挂载 1 行 — acp-agent-minimaxi-quota（MiniMax 套餐额度接口）：SyntaxError: TypeScript parameter property is not supported in strip-only mode
```

readme.section: When a row doesn't mount: the self-report seam
readme.text:
and serves the same ledger as JSON at `GET /acp-agent/health`:
`{ ok, mounted, total, disabled, rows: [{ id, what, status, detail }] }`. `status` is one of
`mounted`, `failed` (module never imported, or `apply` threw), `pending` (waiting on injected
services), `absent` (the composed row never reached the loader tree) or `disabled` (turned off
on purpose — not a failure). No tokens or credentials are in that payload.

readme.section: When a row doesn't mount: the self-report seam
readme.text:
The same line is appended, timestamped, to `$DSH_HOME/logs/acp-agent-health.log` — one line
per boot. That file is the point of the exercise: the desktop app hands the host's stderr to
nobody, so after an incident this is what you can read without rerunning anything.

readme.section: When a row doesn't mount: the self-report seam
readme.text:
Why it exists: on 2026-11-03 a constructor parameter property in `src/minimaxi/credential.ts`
made every row importing it fail under DSH's strip-only TypeScript loader. The host half and
the browser half vanished together with nothing visible in any log; the cause was only found
by probing whether a quota route existed. Two gates now stand in front of that: the audit row
above, and `tests/entry-loadability.spec.ts`, which imports every host entry with a real
`node` (no transform) before a change can ship.

Generic conversation-area UI moved to [`@goodjin2/dsh-chat-area`](https://github.com/acp-agent/dsh-chat-area)
in 2026-11: the answer card, the conversation file cards, the Mermaid renderer and
its host route, and the short session-ID bar. This package keeps the ACP side and
no longer exports `./mermaid-asset` — if your profile still lists
`@goodjin2/dsh-acp-agent/mermaid-asset`, replace it with
`@goodjin2/dsh-chat-area/mermaid-asset` (or drop it; chat-area's own bundle patch
declares it).

Browser layering, when both packages are installed: `assistant-step` renders the
**lowest** priority entry, so chat-area wraps at `-50` and this package at `-40`
(fallback for acp-agent-only installs). Only chat-area declares the seat; a second
declaration throws and is swallowed, which used to make the result depend on
assembly order.

新增独立模型预置（DSH 执行工具），在设置的「Qoder 国际版账号」中浏览器授权。国内版 ACP 预置保留。模型清单登录后由宿主从 Qoder 国际版拉取，选择器以那份为准；真实授权回合尚待验证。详见 [拆解、协议与验证边界](docs/agent-acp/qoder-global.md)。

This repo participates in the container's DSH version-correspondence mechanism: every
plugin repo carries tags named `dsh-<dsh版本>` (e.g. `dsh-0.2.2-rc.1`), each an annotated
tag recording the dsh version it was verified against, the check result, and the date.
The tag is the immutable "known-good coordinate" of that dsh version — a snapshot of
`main` taken the moment the whole-plugin row check went green on every installed host.

- **Why tags instead of releases**: the desktop app reads this checkout by path and the
  web install pulls `repo#ref` — a git tag is already the furthest installable form, so
  no npm publish or GitHub Release is needed.
- **Rollback**: `scripts/pin-to-dsh.sh 0.2.2-rc.1` (from the container) checks out the
  tag in every repo at once; `scripts/check-host-rows.mjs --report` shows which repos are
  on the anchor for the running dsh version.
- **Do not move or delete a `dsh-*` tag**; it is a rollback coordinate. A follow-up fix on
  the same dsh version adds a `-p2` (then `-p3`) suffixed tag instead.
- New tags are cut after each dsh upgrade, as step 4 of the upgrade runbook — see the
  container's `AGENTS.md` for the full flow.
